# Write it simple

> Short programming articles by Juan Manuel Ramallo, mostly Ruby-focused, about practical software, operations, and side projects.

Site: https://1ma.dev
Feed: https://1ma.dev/feed.xml

## Core Topics

- Ruby and Rails
- Simple deployment and operations
- Small-team engineering judgment
- Side projects
- Practical software notes
- Document parsing and data validation
